observations: A white and blue computerized sewing/embroidery machine shown on a bed with patterned sheets in both photos.
The word 'brother' is visible in white script on the front of the machine in photo 1.
A small screen on the machine shows a colorful design, but no model number text is legible in either photo.
No power cord, foot pedal, embroidery hoop, bobbins, or accessory case is visible in either photo.
Both photos appear to be the same staged setup, just different angles/zoom, with a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ABIOLAGNIMACHINE'.
No photo shows the machine powered on, stitching, or any close-up of ports/connectors.

claims.claim: Brother SE630 Computerized Sewing and Embroidery machine
claims.evidence: Brand 'brother' is visible in photo 1, but the SE630 model number is not legible in any photo; seller's text alone does not confirm it.

claims.claim: Suitable to 'upgrade your sewing and embroidery projects' (implying full working order)
claims.evidence: No power-on, stitching, or screen-function clip/photo provided.

risks.risk: Model number cannot be confirmed, and price varies greatly between Brother SE-series models.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model label/plate (usually on the back or base of the machine) or the model shown on the LCD startup screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unspecified/generic Brother sewing-embroidery machine, not specifically as an SE630

risks.risk: Unknown whether the machine powers on or stitches correctly.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine powered on, threading, and completing a test stitch or embroidery pattern.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (foot pedal, power cord, embroidery hoop/arm, bobbins) that are normally essential and costly to replace.
risks.proof: A photo of all included accessories laid out together with the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as machine-only, no accessories included

risks.risk: Hidden physical or mechanical damage (cracked casing, bent needle bar, jammed bobbin case) not visible from the bed-top angles shown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, bobbin compartment, and underside of the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, assume possible hidden wear

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model/serial plate on the machine.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching a sample.
Photo of all included accessories (pedal, cord, hoops, bobbins).
Close-up of needle area and bobbin case for damage check.
response.reason: The specific model (which determines price tier within the Brother SE line) is not legible in either photo, and no proof of power-on function or accessory completeness is shown, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored to the right model.
